scope: 795 approved non-2011 readings only; does not approve excluded or pending source editions
notes: Every approved marker was compared individually against retained native-derived RGB water/sand strips. 0.5m/display pixel and +/-24m context around the approved marker; required contact compatibility within +/-16px.

No unreviewed RGB candidates were promoted and no Hunucma scientific assets were edited.
The source mismatch SC-5-0-156/c52 in release15045 remains excluded; the date/source verified occurrence in release20753 is a distinct approval.
